## Detailed Failures

## Validation Notes

- `html5lib`: current hook passes local representative versions `0.2` and `0.9`. The current report failures for missing `src/html5lib` are stale relative to the current script.
- `kiwisolver`: current hook passes local representative versions `1.1.0` and `1.4.0`. The current report failures for `py/kiwisolver` / `py/src` layout are stale relative to the current script.
- `Crypto`: current hook passes local representative versions `3.10.1` and `3.9.6`. The current report failure for `Crypto.Util._raw_api.load-loop` is stale relative to the current script.

- `plotly`: full local tail recheck now passes for all 36 remaining failed-report versions from `remaining_patch_failures.plotly-tail.json`. The true source history spans at least four resource-loading eras: pre-package-data `0.x`, early package-data `3.x`, early `plotly.data` `4.0.0a*` without bundled dataset files, and later `4.x+` with bundled CSV/GEOJSON datasets. The current hook now handles all four with regex/function-block fallback instead of fixed literal snippets.
- `babel`: current hook passes local representative versions `2.3.0` and `2.15.0`. The current report failures for `locale_identifiers()` and missing `global.dat` are stale relative to the current script.
- `prompt_toolkit`: current hook passes local representative versions `1.0.15`, `2.0.10`, `3.0.0`, and `3.0.52`. The current report failures for `prompt_toolkit.__init__` / `application.application` are stale relative to the current script.
- `prompt_toolkit`: cross-era local validation now passes for `0.1`, `0.30`, `0.60`, `1.0.15`, `2.0.10`, `3.0.0`, and `3.0.50`. Older releases either hardcode `__version__` or lack the later signal-wrapper file, so the broadened hook now no-ops cleanly instead of failing on missing modern snippets.
- `IPython`: cross-era local validation now passes for `0.13.2`, `1.0.0`, `3.2.3`, `4.1.0`, `5.0.0`, and `5.10.0`. The old report failures were caused by literal `from IPython.testing.skipdoctest import skip_doctest` matching; the current regex/function-block patch no longer fails on mixed imports such as `skip_doctest_py2` / `skip_doctest_py3`.
- `isort`: current hook passed full local validation for 153 compatible versions. The current report failures for missing `Lib/isort/_version.py` are stale relative to the current script.
- `jupyterlab`: current hook passes local representative versions `1.0.10`, `1.2.21`, `3.6.8`, and `4.0.9`. The current report failures for missing `coreconfig.py` are stale relative to the current script.
- `jupyter_server`: targeted local recheck now passes for `0.0.1` and `0.0.2` after always generating `Lib/jupyter_server/_staticpython_resources.py` and returning early when that source era has no embedded templates/static/event schemas. Modern file patching is now gated on actual file/resource presence instead of being assumed. The full stale batch still needs rerun before this row can be marked `fixed`.
- `jupyterlab_server`: current hook passes local representative versions `1.2.0`, `2.10.3`, and `2.27.3`. The current report failures for federated extension metadata / settings fallback are stale relative to the current script.
- `pyzmq`: patch-matrix-style local validation now passes for `2.0.7`, `2.0.10`, `2.1.11`, `2.2.0.1`, `14.0.0`, `14.7.0`, `22.3.0`, `25.1.2`, and `27.1.0`. The true source history splits into at least four eras: `2.0.x` and `2.1.x` without bundled build metadata, `2.2.x` with `buildutils/bundle.py` plus `zmq/core/version.py`, `14.x-25.x` with split `backend/cython` legacy sources and `%i.%i.%i` version formatting, and `27.x+` modern `_zmq.py` layout.
- `pyparsing`: patch-matrix-style local validation now passes for `1.5.3`, `1.5.4`, `1.5.5`, `1.5.6`, `2.4.7`, `3.1.4`, and `3.2.5`. The true issue was a mixed source history: `1.5.x` shipped as single-file `pyparsing_py3.py`, `2.4.x` still shipped as single-file `pyparsing.py`, and later releases shipped as a `pyparsing/` package with `unicode.py`.

- `jupyter_client`: patch-matrix-style local validation now passes for all 35 old report versions from `7.0.0a1` through `8.0.0a2`. The old report failures for `jupyter_client local provisioner fallback` are stale relative to the current script.

The current report failures for `validators.py` / `schema.py` embedded schema loading are stale relative to the current script.
- `certifi`: current hook passes local representative versions `0.0.1` and `0.0.2`. The current report failures for missing `Lib/certifi/cacert.pem` were caused by the oldest releases storing `cacert.pem` at the sdist root instead of inside the package.

- `pymongo`: current hook passes local representative versions `0.1pre` and `4.8.0`. The current report failures for missing `gridfs` were caused by the pre-gridfs source era; `gridfs` and legacy `bson` paths are now optional source mappings.
- `rapidfuzz`: current hook passes local representative version `3.14.5`. The current report failures were reproduced earlier as `OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device`, not as a hook mismatch.
- `lark`: current hook passes local representative versions `0.10.1`, `0.11.0`, and `0.12.0`. The expensive package-resource regex was replaced with direct function/text block patching to avoid timeout-scale backtracking on large files.
- `parso`: current hook now passes local representative versions `0.0.1`, `0.0.2`, `0.1.0`, and `0.8.4` after widening both legacy `parso/python/__init__.py` and modern `parso/grammar.py` loader anchors.
- `chardet`: current hook passes local representative versions `1.0`, `3.0.4`, and `7.0.0`. The modern 7.x resource loaders now use regex/function-block matching instead of fixed literal snippets.
- `matplotlib`: patch-matrix-style local validation now passes for `0.86`, `1.0.1`, `3.2.2`, `3.8.4`, and `3.10.9` after making old-source-era files and mappings optional.
- `regex`: current hook now passes local representative versions `2017.07.28` and `2025.7.29`. Newer wheel-only releases fall back to the matching GitHub tag archive so native C sources remain available.
- `Crypto`: current hook now passes local representative versions `3.0`, `3.1`, `3.9.6`, and `3.10.1`. Early pycryptodome releases without `_raw_api.py` or later BLAKE2/Poly1305 sources are now handled by source-era guards.
- `contourpy`: current hook now passes local representative versions `1.0.0` and `1.1.1rc1`. Pre-Meson releases now parse `setup.py` `Pybind11Extension` sources instead of requiring `src/meson.build`.
- `kiwisolver`: patch-matrix-style local validation now passes for all 11 old report versions `0.1.0`, `0.1.1`, `0.1.2`, `0.1.3`, `1.0.0`, `1.0.1`, `1.1.0`, `1.2.0`, `1.3.1`, `1.3.2`, and `1.4.0`. The true issue was a root-layout source era in `0.1.0-0.1.2` where the extension sources lived at the sdist root instead of under `py/`.
- `pybind11`: patch-matrix-style local validation now passes for all 30 old report versions from `2.6.0b1` through `2.13.6`. The report failures were stale after broadening the header layout to accept both `include/pybind11` and `pybind11/include/pybind11`.
- `pymongo`: patch-matrix-style local validation now passes for all 3 old report versions `0.1pre`, `0.1.1pre`, and `0.1.2pre`. The report failures were stale after making `gridfs` and legacy `bson` layouts optional for the pre-gridfs source era.
